pre.speaker: narrator
pre.text: Xiapi, in the winter of the Jian'an years. Lu Bu sits behind a square of brick on the low ground where the Si and the Yi meet, and Cao Cao's engineers have spent a month with spades.

pre.speaker: cao-cao
pre.text: Two rivers, Liu Bei, and one man who will not come out to either. I did not have to climb his wall. I only had to teach the water where to go.

pre.speaker: zhang-fei
pre.text: Water! I have waited since Xuzhou to put a spear in that fellow, and you want to drown him like a rat.

pre.speaker: cao-cao
pre.text: At the end of the third day the outer fields go under, at the end of the fifth the next ring, at the end of the seventh the foot of the wall. Outermost first. Whatever stands in them then will be wading.

pre.speaker: guan-yu
pre.text: Mark it, brother. The fields will be shallows before we reach the gate, and the dyke road is the only dry way in.

pre.speaker: liu-bei
pre.text: Lu Bu once gave me a roof when I had none, and I do not enjoy this. Let us hold the high ground, let the water work, and finish it cleanly. Watch the west gate. I am told not everyone inside loves the man in the middle.

post.speaker: narrator
post.text: The water stands knee-deep in the streets of Xiapi, and the halberd that three brothers could not quite beat at Hulao Gate lies in the mud.

post.speaker: cao-cao
post.text: He asks to be spared, Liu Bei, and says he will serve us both. You knew him longer than I did. Tell me what he is.

post.speaker: liu-bei
post.text: A tiger that bites whoever feeds it. I cannot say it kindly, and I cannot say that I am glad.

post.speaker: narrator
post.text: The captains who wish to live are offered a place, and in Liu Bei's camp the offer is not a trick. Some of the cleverest men in that town have not yet decided what to answer.

post.speaker: liu-bei
post.text: We won today with another man's rivers, Yunchang. I would like, once, to win with our own heads.

post.speaker: guan-yu
post.text: Then find us a better head, brother. I will not mind being outthought if it keeps the men alive.
